name: Demon
fantasy: A winged, horned brute with magma in his cracks. He smashes the ground, charges through foes, hurls molten boulders and calls down meteors.

directions.name: Magma
directions.desc: The fists and the charge: Molten Fists, Infernal Charge and raw fury.

directions.name: Cataclysm
directions.desc: The ground torn open: Infernal Charge, Fault of the Pit and Brimstone Hurl.

directions.name: The Pit
directions.desc: What the pit gives: Hellgrip, Wrath of the Pit and charcoal hide.

skills.name: Molten Fists
skills.desc: A slow blow cracks the ground ahead: 300% weapon damage plus magma, setting foes alight. Branded foes take 30% more and lose the Brand. Dodge to cancel.

skills.name: Infernal Charge
skills.desc: Charge up to 9 m along a burning line. The first champion or player stops you and takes 120% weapon damage plus magma, a stagger and a Brand. Others are bowled aside.

skills.name: Fault of the Pit
skills.desc: Split a 7 m line across your aim. After a warning it erupts: 133% weapon damage plus magma, a knock-up and a Brand. It then burns and slows 35% for 4 s.

skills.name: Brimstone Hurl
skills.desc: Lob a molten boulder up to 14 m, its shadow marking the landing. The 1.3 m core deals 77% weapon damage plus magma and Brands. The 2.6 m edge deals half.

skills.name: Hellgrip
skills.desc: Throw a molten chain 7.5 m. The first foe hooked is dragged in and smashed for 320% weapon damage plus magma. Bosses pull you instead. Branded targets refund 30% cooldown.

skills.name: Wrath of the Pit
skills.desc: Fold your wings for up to 2 s: unstoppable, taking 50% less damage and storing it as heat. Burst within 6 m for 100% weapon damage plus the heat (max 30% of life), hurling foes back in fear. Then meteors rain for 6 s and you deal +40% damage.

skills.name: Volcano
skills.desc: Open a volcano at the pointer. It hurls 5 meteors at nearby foes over 2 s, each dealing 85% weapon damage and setting them alight.

skills.name: Hellbrand Detonation
skills.desc: Every Branded foe within 10 m erupts: 160% weapon damage, a 0.8 s knock-up and fire splashing onto those beside it. The Brands are spent.

skills.name: Blood Pact
skills.desc: Pay 15% of your life: for 8 s gain +35% damage, and 6% of the damage you deal heals you.
